package.description: A high-performance C compiler & VM programming language with English-like syntax and 100% Python capability parity

en-US.description: A high-performance C compiler & VM programming language with English-like syntax and 100% Python capability parity
en-US.longDescription:
VSS (Very Simple Syntax) Version 3.3.3 is a general-purpose programming language invented by Vooka Sai Siddharth.
Built with pure C compiler stack VM, Automatic Reference Counting (ARC), native OS worker threads across physical CPU cores,
and complete feature parity for Web APIs, DataFrames, Data Visualization, Linear Algebra, Databases, and DevFusion 4.0 Smart Campus SaaS.
en-US.name: VSS Programming Language
en-US.publisher: VSS Core Team & Vooka Sai Siddharth
